Description
: Bring a touch of industrial history to your space with this collection of 10 assorted color Hemingray glass insulators. Each piece offers its unique patina, displaying hues of clear, aqua, and light green glass with vintage charm and visible air bubbles, mold seams, and embossed markings. These insulators, once used on telegraph and telephone poles, now offer collectors and decorators a glimpse into classic American utility design. Whether grouped together or displayed individually, their rounded shapes and subtle imperfections enhance their visual appeal. The glass construction ensures long-lasting durability, while the recognizable Hemingray embossing adds legitimacy and collector value. Ideal for display in a curio cabinet, as paperweights, or for upcycling in home decor projects, this lot brings both style and history. All items are in used condition with some signs of age, minor dirt, and expected wear, but no obvious major cracks or chips. Perfect for collectors or those seeking distinctive vintage decor

Glass Insulator Lot - 3 Pieces
Hemingray and American Manufactured
Aqua Teal and Clear, Vintage Mid-Century Era
This collection of three vintage glass insulators represents a significant era in American telecommunications history. Used primarily to insulate telegraph and telephone wires from their wooden support poles, these heavy glass pieces are prized by collectors for their industrial aesthetic and vibrant glass colors. This lot provides a balanced display including a classic aqua teal piece and two clear glass specimens.
Pieces Included:
Hemingray Insulator, Aqua Teal Glass, embossed "HEMINGRAY" with beaded drip points - minor base fleabites
Clear Glass Insulator, embossed "MADE IN U.S.A.", smooth base - excellent vintage condition
Unmarked Clear Glass Insulator, smooth base - excellent vintage condition

description:
Lot of 2 Smoking Pipes Missouri Meerschaum Corn Cob Figural Wood
This lot includes two vintage smoking pipes with distinct styles. The first pipe is a Missouri Meerschaum Original Corn Cob made in the USA, featuring a natural corncob bowl, yellow/amber acrylic stem, and a black ring accent, along with an original paper label. The second pipe is a handcrafted wooden figural pipe carved to resemble a man's face wearing a fez-style hat, with inlaid white bead eyes, dark wood inlay details, and twig-like wood accents forming facial hair. Both pipes display wear and patina consistent with their age and show craftsmanship typical of collectible smoking pipes.

Hemingray, Ohio Valley Glass Co. (O.V.G. Co.)
Aqua and Teal Green, Vintage
Collection of three vintage glass insulators originally utilized for telegraph and telephone line insulation. This lot features insulators from prominent American manufacturers, showcasing the industrial aqua and teal green glass common to early 20th-century utility production. These heavy pressed glass pieces are sought after for their historical industrial aesthetic and display appeal.

Insulator, Aqua, marked "O.V.G. CO." - features a large chip on the side and base
Insulator, Teal Green, marked "N 21" - internal vertical crack visible on the crown
Insulator, Aqua/Teal, marked "HEMINGRAY" - exhibits surface scratching and minor flea bites

The Hemingray piece retains its shape but shows signs of outdoor weathering and light surface wear. Recommended for rustic decor or craft projects.

Description
: Discover a unique addition to your collection with this vintage collectible tin containing an assortment of rough mineral and rock specimens. The classic metal tin, featuring charming imagery from The Saturday Evening Post dated May 7, 1932, adds nostalgic appeal and a decorative touch, making this set perfect for display as well as storage. Inside, you'll find a variety of unpolished mineral stones in assorted natural shadesearthy browns, creamy whites, rusty reds, yellows, and the occasional black or grayeach one offering its own distinctive shape, color, and surface texture. These handpicked rocks are ideal for beginner geologists, educational collections, or anyone who enjoys the raw beauty of natural minerals. The metal tin keeps everything together and displays well on shelves or desks. Please note that both the tin and the stones show typical evidence of age and handling, including small surface marks and overall wear, which only add to their authentic, timeworn character

BlendJet 2
Portable Blender, Geode Swirl Pattern
Cordless and Water-Resistant
The BlendJet 2 is a versatile portable blender that offers the freedom to create smoothies, protein shakes, and mixed drinks while on the go. This specific unit features a vibrant pastel marble or "geode" swirl pattern, making it a stylish addition to a fitness or travel kit.
USB-C rechargeable base with a water-resistant design and quiet operation
BPA-free blending jar featuring ounce and milliliter measurement markings
Integrated carrying strap and leak-proof lid for easy transport
Includes a black insulated zippered sleeve and the original retail packaging

Description:
Capture the spirit of adventure and discovery with this captivating vintage Agate Geode Diorama. Inside a hand-cut agate geode, which showcases natural layers of colorful mineral bands, stands a detailed metal figurine of a bearded miner wielding a pickaxe. Beside him, a faithful pack donkey is carefully sculpted and packed for the journey, set against the sparkling mineral backdrop. These crafted elements highlight the heritage of mining and exploration, making this piece both visually stunning and historically evocative. The blend of natural stone beauty and intricate metalwork offers a unique statement for shelves, desks, or curio cabinets. The piece is sturdy, displays beautifully from multiple angles, and easily fits into mining or mineral collections. Its versatile size makes it an ideal conversation starter and a memorable gift for collectors or anyone who appreciates geology and craftsmanship. Condition is good, with visible minor roughness typical for raw stone edges. No major chips or damage are observed

description:
Mary Kay
Assorted Beauty and Makeup Collection Lot
Multiple Full and Travel Sizes Included
This extensive collection of Mary Kay cosmetic and skincare products includes a wide variety of mineral makeup compact refills and daily care essentials. Featured within the lot is a large assortment of Mary Kay mineral cheek colors, mineral highlighting powders, mineral bronzing powders, mineral shimmer powders, eye intrigue quads, and limited edition filigree eye and cheek powders in varied shades such as Pink Stardust, Sunny Spice, Citrus Bloom, Bronze Diva, Canary Diamond, and Sparkling Cider. Also included is a package of 30 disposable facial cloths, two tubes of Satin Hands hand cream and softener, and a Satin Hands pump dispenser bottle.
Large selection of individual mineral face powder and cheek color pans in clear protective cases
Includes Mary Kay Satin Hands hand creams and liquid cleansing pump bottle
Includes 30-count pack of Mary Kay disposable facial cleansing cloths
Wide range of neutral, pink, bronze, and shimmering tones suitable for refillable magnetic compact palettes
Compact dimensions approximately 8 x 8 x 8 inches boxed; total weight approximately 5.0 lbs
Condition:
Overall very good condition. Makeup compact pans appear unused in their protective plastic snap covers. Facial cloths remain sealed in manufacturer packaging. Exterior containers and cases show light cosmetic shelf wear from storage.

description: This lot features a variety of polished stones and minerals, including tumbled stones, slabs, chips, and rough pieces. The collection includes specimens that appear to be agate, jasper, quartz, amethyst, sodalite, petrified wood, and possibly a fossilized shark tooth. The stones come in different shapes, colors, and patterns, with both natural and polished finishes. The pieces show minor surface wear consistent with handling but have no significant damage visible.

description:
Hemingray Glass Company
No. 55 Transposition Insulator (CD 205)
Pressed Glass, Aqua Blue, Vintage Early to Mid-20th Century
Vintage Hemingray No. 55 CD 205 aqua glass transposition insulator, historically utilized on rural telephone and power transmission lines to rotate and swap wire positions to minimize electrical crosstalk interference. Manufactured in Muncie, Indiana, this distinctive style of American industrial glass remains a popular favorite among telegraph, utility, and antique glass collectors.
Distinctive transposition profile featuring spiral wire guide channels across the upper dome
Pressed aqua blue glass containing natural manufacturing swirl patterns and authentic seed air bubbles
Embossed "HEMINGRAY" on the front skirt and "N 55" on the reverse skirt, featuring a smooth base rim
Measures approximately 4 inches in diameter by 4 inches in height
Condition:
Embossed lettering remains crisp and well-defined. Glass exhibits brilliant gloss with typical factory mold seams and minor light surface contact marks consistent with authentic utility use. A minor fleabite flake is present on the edge of the interior skirt rim. Free of major cracks, repairs, or structural breaks.

Combined Shipping Policy:
We’re happy to offer combined shipping when items meet ShopGoodwill’s combined-shipping eligibility criteria and can be safely packaged together.If the combined-shipping option is available at checkout, please proceed with payment and your items will be shipped together at a reduced shipping charge. If the option isn’t offered, the items must be purchased and shipped separately.
Please note: It is against our policy to override the ShopGoodwill system or create a combined shipment when the system does not allow it.
Mixing Flat-Rate & Dimensional Weight Items
When an order includes both flat-rate and dimensional-weight items, shipping may be calculated using dimensional weight. Combining these items does not necessarily reduce shipping costs and may result in the same or higher shipping charges than purchasing them separately.
For this reason, customers may want to consider purchasing flat-rate and dimensional-weight items in separate orders.
Flat-Rate Shipping
Flat-rate shipping charges are fixed and
cannot be adjusted or discounted
.
When multiple flat-rate items are purchased together, the shipping charge for each item is added to the order. For example, if three items each have a $5.99 flat-rate shipping charge, the total shipping charge will be $17.97
Shipping via FedEx:
All items will ship via FedEx. FedEx shipping charges are calculated using the dimensional weight (volume) or the actual weight of the shipped package - whichever weight is higher. The listed weight of this item(s) may reflect the dimensional shipping charge for the final package, and not the actual weight of the item(s). FedEx cannot ship to a Military Box, PO Box, or Puerto Rico. Orders with a tracking number assigned on a weekend are picked up by the carrier on Monday afternoon. Any order with items totaling $300 or more will automatically require a signature.

description:
Natural Mineral Specimen
Selenite Gypsum Crystal Slab on Matrix Rock
Rough Geological Specimen, Approximately 6.5 x 5 x 1.5 Inches
This natural geological specimen consists of a substantial plate of translucent crystalline selenite (gypsum) anchored to a sandy sedimentary rock matrix. Selenite crystal plates of this type form through evaporation in saline basins and exhibit distinct basal cleavage, glassy to pearly surface luster, and natural surface texturing. Specimens retaining their natural host rock provide valuable educational and aesthetic display value for mineral collectors.
Translucent crystalline gypsum (selenite) formation showing natural cleavage planes and surface pitting
Adhering host matrix of tan and greenish sedimentary sandstone on the underside and outer edges
Natural raw formation with fibrous crystal growth visible along perimeter margins
Measures approximately 6.5 inches long by 5 inches wide by 1.5 inches thick and weighs 2 lbs
Condition:
Natural geological specimen in rough, as-found condition. The crystalline face shows natural etchings, surface cleavage steps, and minor peripheral chipping typical of raw selenite. The sandy matrix base exhibits natural roughness, light particulate shedding, and mineral staining.

completing payment
! If you leave the order screen during checkout on a BIN item, site and order errors can occur! Contact us via a Customer Service Ticket for information regarding BIN item shipping combinations.

Unless otherwise stated in the listing, items do not come with official certificates and will not include documentation. You are bidding with this in mind. IMPORTANT NOTES:
Once an order is paid for, there will be no refunds on combined shipping if you did not ask for it prior to paying for your order. We will not retract bids from an item once an auction ends. Bids can only be removed from open/active auctions at our discretion. There is no guarantee that we will approve your retraction request. We do not offer extensions past the payment due date of an item. Items are automatically relisted once the payment deadline expires. Requests for extensions will be denied. We do not cancel orders. WILL NOT CANCEL ORDERS DUE TO SHIPPING COSTS.

PHOTOGRAPHS:
All photographs are considered to be part of the description of the item, please be sure to review them before placing your bid. We DO NOT color enhance our photos. All photos are taken with iPhones and under LED lighting. Due to the way individuals see colors, the differences in color computer monitors and cameras there may be slight variations and or differences between the actual item and the photographs. There are no returns accepted on any item for color variation.
TESTING:
All of our jewelry offerings are tested prior to going to auction. We use a Thermo Scientific Niton DXL Metal Analyzer to test for precious metals and or JSP Acid Solution Testing in conjunction with the aforementioned analyzer.
We describe each item to the best of our ability; however, we are
NOT
experts in any field. All gemstones are measured using electronic calipers.
All gemstones are tested on a Presidium Gemstone Tester. This equipment CANNOT determine between natural, lab created and synthetic gemstones. There are no returns accepted for lab created or synthetic gemstones.
Items may be vintage, antique or newer. There is still a chance that the stones can become loose or that a connector may need to be tightened. We are as delicate as possible with the items, but there is a possibility we may miss the flaw or that it may happen during shipment. No refunds permitted or given for gemstones that become dislodged from their setting in or during shipment.
TERMINOLOGY USED IN OUR LISTINGS:
The definition of the word
stone(s)
can be anything at all. It is only being used as more of a descriptive word/placeholder. These can be anything from genuine gemstone, lab created, synthetic, glass, plastic or crystal "stones". Unless specifically stated as gemstone(s) there will be no returns accepted for jewelry where the word "stone(s)" is used in our listing. Please make sure you understand and take that into account before placing a bid.
Pearls are tested to the best of our ability for texture and layering. They are not professionally tested. Pearls that do not pass the texture and layering test are labeled "faux". The approximate diameter is provided for size only, and the pearl(s) may or may not be perfectly round. 90% of the world's pearls are now cultured and are not naturally occurring. We cannot distinguish between cultured and natural pearls. You are bidding with this knowledge in mind.
Color, when we describe the color (of a stone, gem, bead, or anything that is described by a color), we may have different lighting than you & some of us see colors differently. Please know that the color that is described could be slightly different & a return will not be accepted for this reason.

Bakelite has been identified via the scrubbing bubbles test or metal polish.

We generally do not work weekends and therefore shipping is not done on those days. Merchandise ships within 5 days of receipt of payment as per website policy. description:
Polished Gemstone & Crystal Collection
Natural Mineral Specimens
Total Weight: 2.2 lbs
This diverse collection features a variety of natural mineral specimens, centered around a large clear-to-cloudy quartz crystal cluster. The assortment includes a white satin spar (selenite) wand, a clear faceted quartz point, and an array of polished tumbled stones in a spectrum of colors including blue, pink, purple, and earth tones. Ideal for geological study, home decor, or as a foundational set for mineral collectors.
Large quartz crystal cluster with visible prismatic terminations
Satin spar (selenite) wand with characteristic fibrous silky luster
Clear faceted quartz crystal point
Assortment of approximately 15 polished tumbled stones in various sizes and colors

description:
Hemingray Glass Company Set - 2 Pieces
Hemingray 42 (CD 154)
Aqua, Vintage Mid-Century
This set features two vintage aqua glass insulators produced by the Hemingray Glass Company, identified by the "Hemingray-42" mold mark. The No. 42 model, classified as CD 154 by collectors, was one of the most widely used designs for telephone and telegraph lines across North America during the early-to-mid 20th century. Prized for their deep aqua color and iconic industrial aesthetic, these pieces represent a significant era of American telecommunications history and are staple items for glass insulator collectors.
Pieces Included:
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Glass Insulator, Hemingray 42, Aqua, Beaded Base - minor fleabites on drip points
Condition:
Both insulators are in good vintage condition with characteristic wear expected from outdoor utility use. The glass retains high clarity and its original vibrant aqua hue. As is common with authentic vintage insulators, there are minor fleabites and small chips along the sharp drip points on the beaded base. No large structural cracks or major damage to the wire grooves or top domes observed.
